verdict.rationale: Stripe's hosted MCP server exposes `stripe_api_write`, and its documented supported methods explicitly include creating and updating products, prices, and payment links. An agent can therefore chain all three creates in one session. A live probe confirms the OAuth-gated MCP endpoint, and the docs add agent-ready sandboxes, restricted keys scoped for agents, and idempotency keys for safe retries. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end product→price→payment link flow completed by an agent in a single session.
